look_here_first: Find ONE mature compound leaf and count its leaflets. Twoleaf senna has exactly ONE PAIR of usually long, narrow lance-shaped leaflets (roughly 2–9 times longer than wide), with a small gland near their junction. This quickly separates S. lindheimeriana with 4–8 pairs, but NOT every western Senna: S. pilosior and S. bauhinioides also have one pair. Confirm leaflet proportions, flowers and pods.

lookalikes.differences: S. lindheimeriana is taller and velvety with 4–8 pairs of leaflets. S. pilosior is an annual western/desert comparison. The exactly-two-leaflet leaf is the fastest field character.
